name: ai-kitchen
description: Open-source Claude Code skills from ai-kitchen in two tiers: core (always-on developer workflow) and bespoke (occasional, specialised).

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Core developer-workflow skills used all the time: commit discipline, opening and reviewing PRs, testing, and fixing lint/test failures.

plugins.name: bespoke
plugins.description: Occasional, specialised developer skills: changelogs, READMEs, CI setup, licensing and SPDX headers, .gitignore, and frontend design.
